Subject: Novalytiq onboarding — model fit and context needs

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to begin the formal handoff to Customer Success/Implementation and want to lock down a recommended model shortlist and a first-pass token volume estimate so our infra and procurement teams can budget. High-level specifics:

- Product use case: in-app technical support assistant (ticket summarization + guided troubleshooting + code snippet sanitizer).
- Expected traffic: 350k MAUs, conservatively 1.8M active sessions/month (support flows only).
- Typical session: 3.2 prompts per session (user messages + system context), average user prompt ~900 tokens, expected assistant reply ~650 tokens.
- Context needs: we may need to include last 8–12 messages (~2–4k tokens) plus a 3–4k token document context (knowledge snippets from KB), so peak context requirement could be 8k–12k tokens per request for certain flows.
- SLA: sub-700ms tail latency for interactive channels; procurement asks for a cost ballpark.

Attached is a lightweight traffic snapshot (CSV) with hourly peaks and session samples. Can you confirm what model families we should shortlist (32k vs 8k context variants), and a rough monthly token estimate and recommended approach (caching / prompt truncation / rerankers) for the initial rollout? Also flag anything that would force a Dedicated deployment vs hosted.

Appreciate your help — Kelsey

--
Kelsey Ramos
Head of Product

Quick sizing from my side (first-pass, ballpark):

Assumptions derived from Kelsey's CSV + stated averages:
- Sessions/month: 1.8M
- Prompts/session: 3.2 -> total requests/month ≈ 5.76M
- Avg user prompt: 900 tokens; avg reply: 650 tokens -> per-request payload ~1,550 tokens (not including long context)
- High-context flows (10% of requests): add 8k tokens of context = +8,000 tokens on those requests

Token math (monthly):
- Baseline requests (90%): 5.184M * 1,550 ≈ 8.05B tokens
- High-context (10%): 576k * (1,550 + 8,000) ≈ 5.12B tokens
- Total month ≈ 13.17B tokens

Model shortlist (recommended):
1) 32k-context variant — for high-context flows. Candidate: Llama-3-32k or equivalent (quantized) for hosted with strict context fidelity. Use caching to avoid repeatedly sending full KB blobs when unchanged.
2) 8k-context performant family — Mistral-like 8k variant or Llama-3-8k for baseline interactive traffic. Lower cost and better latency.
3) Hybrid: route ~90% traffic to 8k variant; detect high-context intents and route to 32k variant (smart routing via Redwood policies). Fallback: smaller distilled model for quick clarifications.

Throughput & deployment notes:
- For 5.76M requests/month (~2.7 requests/sec average, but peak hour multiplier 8x from CSV), estimate peak concurrent requests ~22 req/s.
- Hosted should be fine for initial months; Dedicated becomes cost-efficient when sustained peak and monthly tokens push north of ~30B tokens or when isolation/SLA + predictable throughput needed.

Cost sensitivity and ops knobs:
- Use prefix/KV caching for KB blocks (could reduce 32k-context token load by ~30% depending on reuse).
- Aggressive truncation for lower-importance metadata and structural rerank to keep tokens down.
- Batching at gateway level with 50–100ms max hold can improve throughput cost but watch latency tails for interactive sessions.

Attachments: model-cost-estimates.pdf (includes per-token ballpark and Dedicated break-even calc). I can expand this into a short MAP v1 for Priya to send.

Recap recommendation: start hosted with the hybrid routing strategy (8k baseline, 32k for high-context). Monitor token mix and conversion to Dedicated at 3-month review.

- Ben
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Subject: Novalytiq onboarding: recommended shortlist + next steps (MAP v1)

Hi Kelsey and Samir —

Thanks for the traffic snapshot and for meeting with us last week. Attached is a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP v1) and the internal cost/sizing PDF Ben shared. Summary and next steps below:

Executive summary:
- Recommended initial architecture: hybrid routing on Redwood hosted API. Route ~90% baseline interactive traffic to an 8k-context production model (recommended family: Llama-3-8k-like or Mistral 8k equivalently tuned). Route ~10% high-context flows (document-heavy support cases) to a 32k-context variant.
- First-pass monthly token estimate: ~13.2B tokens (see Ben's breakdown). With caching and truncation we project 9.5–11.0B tokens effective billable.
- Suggested SLO: p95 <= 420ms for 8k path; p95 <= 750ms for 32k path.

Immediate asks for Novalytiq:
1) Confirm which flows require document-level fidelity vs short conversational context (we've flagged the KB-heavy support use case as the initial 10% high-context bucket).
2) Share a sample of the KB blobs (Drive link is fine) so we can validate compressibility and caching benefits.
3) Procurement: if you want a dedicated pricing estimate, confirm a 12-month expected token commitment (use the attached MAP to provide a working number).

Planned Redwood deliverables by next Wednesday (02/23):
- MAP v1 (attached) with milestones, owners, and a 6-week implementation timeline.
- Implementation checklist (auth, routing policy, prompt templates, eviction policy for cache).
- A short spike: run a blue/green test of a high-context sample over a 48h window to measure observed token reuse.

Attachments: MAP-Novalytiq-v1.docx, model-cost-estimates.pdf

I'll set up a 30-min follow-up with Kelsey & Samir next week to walk the MAP. Ben and Grace — we'll need you on the spike execution.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
